title: Migrating plaintext sessions without locking yourself out
focus: An operator-focused look at the prompt-scrub sessions encrypt path: why the command refuses to fabricate a session id that does not exist, why --rekey demands the OLD passphrase and never silently overwrites a file it cannot decrypt, what the encrypted/skipped/missing counts mean in the summary, and how the new SessionDecryptionError makes wrong-key and tampered-file cases distinguishable from genuinely expired sessions.
